archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast mixed with Electric & Neon (Restrained)

brand.name: Nexolash
brand.positioning: Deep-tech engineering company building intelligent systems for mobility, automation, enterprise AI, cloud-native infrastructure, robotics, and research-driven innovation.
brand.vibe: Premium futuristic, dark mode first, minimal but technical, clean grid-based layout, strong typography, subtle animations.

headings.usage: All section titles, hero headlines, and large numerical data.

body.usage: Paragraphs, card descriptions, navigation links, buttons.

cards.style: bg-[#0D0D12] border border-white/10 hover:border-[#2979FF]/50 transition-colors duration-300

image_urls.description: Abstract futuristic cyber landscape with digital matrix and glowing lights. Use as a subtle background behind the right-side Hero section or embedded within the AI network visual.
Abstract image of ethereal fiber optic strands cascading with glowing blue lights. Use for the Research Lab section hero image.
Abstract blue and teal light streaks on dark background. Good for Cloud Deployment or EV Intelligence card backgrounds.
Abstract geometric lines and shapes on black background. Good for AI Architecture or Integration cards.

sections_breakdown.name: Sticky Navbar
sections_breakdown.instructions: Use glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#05050A]/70). Left: Text logo 'Nexolash' in Space Grotesk font-bold text-white. Center: Nav links in Inter text-sm text-zinc-400 hover:text-white. Right: Primary CTA button 'Get Started' with electric blue background.

sections_breakdown.name: Hero Section
sections_breakdown.instructions: Split layout grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2. Left: H1 headline 'Engineering the Future of Intelligence', subheadline text-zinc-400, two buttons (Primary Electric Blue, Secondary outline white/10). Below buttons: Trust badges using react-icons/si (e.g., SiOpenai, SiNvidia, SiGooglecloud, SiAmazonaws, SiIbm) in text-zinc-500. Right: Animated AI network visual utilizing a combination of glowing CSS nodes and the 'hero_background' image.

sections_breakdown.name: Solutions Section
sections_breakdown.instructions: 7 premium cards. Use a Bento Grid layout (e.g., first two cards span 2 cols each, next three span 1 col, etc.). Dark flat cards with 1px border-white/10. On hover, change border to electric blue and add a subtle glow shadow.

sections_breakdown.name: Architecture Stack Section
sections_breakdown.instructions: Visual representation of a tech stack. Stack 3-4 horizontal wide cards or CSS layers with isometric transforms. Use strong typography to denote layers (e.g., Application Layer, AI Framework Layer, Cloud Infrastructure Layer).

sections_breakdown.name: Industries Section
sections_breakdown.instructions: 6 large premium cards in a 2x3 or 3x2 grid. Each card represents an industry (e.g., Mobility, Enterprise, Robotics). Use large Lucide icons and minimal text.

sections_breakdown.name: Process Section
sections_breakdown.instructions: Horizontal timeline. 5 steps: Discover, Design, Build, Deploy, Scale. Use a horizontal line with glowing nodes and text below each node. Mobile: Stack vertically.

sections_breakdown.name: Research Lab Section
sections_breakdown.instructions: 5 research areas. Feature a large visual area using 'research_lab' image alongside an accordion or list of research areas (e.g., Quantum AI, Autonomous Systems).

sections_breakdown.name: Internal Projects Section
sections_breakdown.instructions: 3 project cards. Each card must distinctly show: Problem, Approach, Tech Stack, and Status. Use a badge component for 'Status' (e.g., Active, In R&D).

sections_breakdown.name: Why Choose Us Section
sections_breakdown.instructions: 6 cards grid. Focus on metrics, reliability, and engineering superiority. Clean layout, technical iconography.

sections_breakdown.name: CTA Banner
sections_breakdown.instructions: Full width banner with a deep gradient glow or tracing beam border. Large headline, strong CTA. Darkest background to make it pop.

sections_breakdown.name: Contact Section
sections_breakdown.instructions: Split layout. Left: Contact info (Email, HQ, placeholder phone). Right: Frontend-only form. Use Shadcn-like inputs but heavily customized with dark styling (bg-black border-white/10 focus:border-electric-blue). Include a 'Send Message' button.

sections_breakdown.name: Footer
sections_breakdown.instructions: Clean multi-column layout. Very large top padding (py-32). Left: Massive 'Nexolash' logo. Right: Columns for Solutions, Company, Legal, Social. Bottom: Copyright and social links using react-icons/si.

testing_requirements.instructions: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case. Example: data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='contact-form-submit'.
